name: 猫猫猪猪
tagline: 贴贴 比心 晚安
note: 毛绒 3D 软萌风，参考可可和嘟嘟的节奏但角色原创。不加字，靠表情和小动作；动作轻柔，停在最萌的一下。

stickers.caption: 贴贴
stickers.action: The kitten and the piglet lean in and squish their fluffy cheeks together, rubbing cheeks side to side happily with eyes closed, tiny pink blush glowing.

stickers.caption: 比心
stickers.action: The kitten holds up a small pink felted heart with both paws toward the camera, the heart wobbles softly, the kitten blinks and smiles.

stickers.caption: 委屈
stickers.action: The piglet's lower lip trembles, big glossy teary eyes slowly well up, two tiny tears roll down its cheeks, it sniffles.

stickers.caption: 偷看
stickers.action: The kitten slowly peeks out from behind the edge of a wooden door, one eye and one ear appear, it blinks curiously, then quickly hides back.

stickers.caption: 晚安
stickers.action: The piglet is tucked under a tiny patchwork quilt, it yawns big, its eyes slowly close, a little crescent moon sparkle twinkles above.

stickers.caption: 干饭
stickers.action: The kitten munches a tiny felted watermelon slice with both paws, cheeks puffing out with each bite, eyes happily closed.

stickers.caption: 摸摸头
stickers.action: The kitten gently pats the piglet on the head with one paw, the piglet closes its eyes and smiles contentedly, leaning into the pat.

stickers.caption: 害羞
stickers.action: The piglet covers its face with its little hooves, cheeks blushing deep pink, it wiggles shyly side to side and peeks through its hooves.
